Variants.Content: A naval blockade uses fleets to control port entrances and nearby waterways, blocking food, reinforcements and trade. A truly effective blockade requires rotating patrols, shore supplies and knowledge of tidal reefs; bad weather, darkness and small boat stowaways can all leave gaps.

Entry Naval Blockade A naval blockade uses fleets to control port entrances and nearby waterways, blocking food, reinforcements and trade. A truly effective blockade requires rotating patrols, shore supplies and knowledge of tidal reefs; bad weather, darkness and small boat stowaways can all leave gaps. The rules of the sea ultimately have to withstand wet ropes, bad water and sudden turns of weather.
